detail.disclaimer: These checks are hints, not a legal or tax assessment.

codes.BF-XML-UNREADABLE: The XML file can't be read. It may be damaged or incomplete.
codes.BF-XML-DOCTYPE: The XML file contains a document type declaration (DOCTYPE). E-invoices never need one, so it was not processed, for safety.
codes.BF-XML-ENCODING: Belegfluss only reads XML in UTF-8, the usual encoding for e-invoices.
codes.BF-NOT-AN-INVOICE: This file is XML, but not an invoice in a format Belegfluss knows (XRechnung or EN 16931, as UBL or CII).
codes.BF-PDF-UNREADABLE: The PDF file can't be read. It may be damaged.
codes.BF-PDF-ENCRYPTED: The PDF is password-protected, so its contents can't be read.
codes.BF-UNSTRUCTURED: This document has no machine-readable invoice data (a plain PDF or a photo). Automatic reading of such documents is coming soon.
codes.BF-VALIDATOR-NOT-PROCESSABLE: The official validator could not process this invoice, so it was not checked against the official rules.
codes.BF-VALIDATOR-NO-SCENARIO: The official validator has no rules for this kind of invoice (for example a ZUGFeRD profile or another standard), so it was not checked against the official rules. Belegfluss checked the amounts itself.
codes.BF-NOT-AN-E-INVOICE: According to the Federal Ministry of Finance, the ZUGFeRD profiles MINIMUM and BASIC WL are not e-invoices. Ask the supplier for an invoice in a full profile.
codes.BF-SMALL-AMOUNT: Small-amount invoice (total up to €250): fewer details are required (§ 33 UStDV), and it doesn't have to be an e-invoice.
codes.BF-FOREIGN-CURRENCY: The invoice is in {currency}, not in euros.
codes.BF-VAT-RATE-UNUSUAL: The standard VAT category uses {rate} %. In Germany the rates are 19 % and 7 %.
codes.BF-VAT-AMOUNT: The VAT for {rate} % should be {expected}, but the invoice says {actual}.
codes.BF-TOTAL-GROSS: Total without VAT plus VAT gives {expected}, but the invoice total is {actual}.
codes.BF-TOTAL-LINES: The items add up to {expected}, but the invoice says {actual}.
codes.BF-MISSING-SELLER-ADDRESS: The supplier's full address is missing.
codes.BF-MISSING-BUYER-ADDRESS: The customer's full address is missing.
codes.BF-MISSING-TAX-ID: The supplier's VAT ID or tax number is missing.
codes.BF-MISSING-ITEMS: Quantity and description of the goods or services are missing or incomplete.
codes.BF-MISSING-DELIVERY-DATE: The delivery or service date (or period) is missing.
codes.BF-MISSING-VAT: The VAT rate or the reason for a VAT exemption is missing.
codes.BF-PDF-NO-TEXT: The visible PDF has no text layer (for example a scan), so it couldn't be compared with the XML.
codes.BF-PDF-XML-MISMATCH-NUMBER: The invoice number {number} from the XML doesn't appear in the visible PDF. The XML is legally leading: compare both before you pay.
codes.BF-PDF-XML-MISMATCH-TOTAL: The total {amount} from the XML doesn't appear in the visible PDF. The XML is legally leading: compare both before you pay.
codes.BF-DUPLICATE: Another document has the same supplier and invoice number. It may be the same invoice twice.
codes.BR-CO-10: The sum of the item amounts (BT-106) doesn't match the individual items.
codes.BR-CO-13: The total without VAT (BT-109) doesn't match items minus allowances plus charges.
codes.BR-CO-14: The total VAT (BT-110) doesn't match the VAT amounts per rate.
codes.BR-CO-15: The total with VAT (BT-112) is not the total without VAT plus the VAT.
codes.BR-CO-16: The amount due (BT-115) doesn't match the total minus amounts already paid plus rounding.
codes.BR-CO-17: A VAT amount per rate (BT-117) is not the taxable amount times the rate.
codes.BR-S-08: For a standard VAT rate, the taxable amount (BT-116) doesn't match the items, allowances and charges at that rate.
codes.BR-S-09: For a standard VAT rate, the VAT amount (BT-117) is not the taxable amount times the rate.
codes.BR-01: The invoice doesn't say which standard it follows (BT-24).
codes.BR-08: The supplier's postal address (BG-5) is missing.
codes.BR-10: The customer's postal address (BG-8) is missing.
codes.BR-DE-1: Payment details (BG-16), such as the bank account, are missing.
codes.BR-DE-2: The supplier's contact details (BG-6) are missing.
codes.BR-DE-15: The buyer reference (BT-10) is missing. XRechnung requires it.
codes.BR-DE-16: The supplier's VAT ID or tax number (BT-31/BT-32) is missing.
codes.BR-DE-17: The invoice type code (BT-3) is not one of the codes XRechnung allows.
codes.BR-DE-21: The standard identifier (BT-24) is not the XRechnung identifier. The invoice may follow another standard.
codes.BR-DE-TMP-32: The delivery date (BT-72) or a service period (BG-14 or BG-26 on every item) should be stated.
codes.BF-AI-READ: This document was read by AI. Please compare the fields with the document before you approve it.
codes.BF-AI-NOT-IN-DOCUMENT: {field, select, number {The invoice number} vat_id {The VAT ID} iban {The IBAN} gross {The total} issue_date {The invoice date} due_date {The due date} other {A value}} read by AI does not appear in the document's text. It may be misread.
codes.BF-AI-INVALID-IBAN: The IBAN {value} has wrong check digits. It is probably misread.
codes.BF-AI-INVALID-VAT-ID: The VAT ID {value} doesn't have a valid format.
codes.BF-AI-IMPLAUSIBLE-DATE: {field, select, number {The invoice number} vat_id {The VAT ID} iban {The IBAN} gross {The total} issue_date {The invoice date} due_date {The due date} other {A value}} looks implausible (in the future, very old, or before the invoice date).
codes.BF-IMAGE-UNREADABLE: The image can't be read. It may be damaged or too large.
codes.BF-AI-NOT-AN-INVOICE: The AI found no invoice or receipt in this document.
codes.BF-AI-FAILED: The AI could not read this document. Please check it yourself, or upload a clearer copy.
